subject: [AMBER] Installation of ambertools on 32 bit linux system

messages.author: Prasanth G, Research Scholar
messages.body:
Dear all,
Can someone help me with the installation of 32 bit version of ambertools -
19.
I tried installing it using miniconda but I guess only 64 bit version is
available through this method.
If the latest versions does not support 32 bit, could you please guide me
as to which was the last version that supported 32 bit and where to find
the file for installation.
Thank you.
-- 
Regards,
Prasanth.

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Apr 06, 2020, Prasanth G, Research Scholar wrote:
>
>Can someone help me with the installation of 32 bit version of ambertools -
>19.
>
>I tried installing it using miniconda but I guess only 64 bit version is
>available through this method.
Does it work if you add --skip-python to the configuration flags?  You
can also set the --with-python flag to ask Amber to use a python
executable you may already have.
I don't know of any efforts to build on 32-bit linux in a long time.
Maybe others on the list will know something about this, but I'm
guessing you will have to experiment.  You definitely don't want to go
back to an older version.
...good luck....dac
